title: Enterprise security milestone orchestrator & evidence harmonization
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Build a cross-functional Milestone Orchestrator that centralizes compliance evidence, automates recurring collection (SSO/SAML assertions, audit logs, KMS access records), and exposes gateable milestones tied to SOC2/ISO controls and product OKRs. This ticket defines scope, timeline, acceptance criteria, and handoffs for a minimal viable orchestration to support enterprise onboarding and audit readiness. Background: multiple teams currently track evidence in scattered Confluence pages and Drive folders; auditors and sales frequently request consolidated packages which slows enterprise sales cycles. The Orchestrator should reduce evidence collection time, lower manual errors, and enable automated gating for Private/Dedicated deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Central evidence index created that maps artifacts to SOC2/ISO control IDs and internal milestone names
Automated collectors for SSO (SAML idp logs) and audit-log exports run on schedule and surface missing artifacts
One-click export that generates an auditor-ready evidence ZIP with provenance metadata
Console dashboard shows per-customer and per-control completeness with a freshness timestamp
Rollout gating: prevent Private environment promotion if P0 controls are missing; demo in pilot with two enterprise accounts
milestones: Design & API contracts: 2026-03-16 -> 2026-03-29 (schema for evidence, retention policy)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: SAML provider variability; Mitigation: adapter pattern with per-idp extractor + sample harness
Risk: Evidence retention and PII in artifacts; Mitigation: automated redaction step + legal review
Risk: Large audit-log volumes; Mitigation: incremental collectors with cursoring and sampling for exports
Risk: Cross-team coordination delays; Mitigation: weekly stakeholder sync + clear owner list
